name: Marigold V2 — surface normals from a photo
description:
Upload a photo and Marigold V2 returns a surface-normal map: every pixel is coloured by the direction the surface faces — the ground facing up comes out green, surfaces facing the camera come out lilac. Useful for relighting, as a normal-map guide for other workflows, or for 3D and texture work.

There is no prompt and no seed: it runs a single deterministic step, so the same photo always gives the same map. 'Detail' sets how many megapixels the photo is processed at. 1 MP is the model's native size and takes only a few seconds; higher values keep finer detail, but the time grows with the pixel count.

This workflow runs without the optional Sage attention speed-up (it produces a black image with it), so ComfyUI restarts without it when this workflow is served.
author: Template - ComfyUI

exposedParameters.label: Detail (megapixels — 1 is the model's native size)
